Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prioritization framework + interim role transfers (QBR prep)

Team —

Attaching a short prioritization framework and a proposed set of interim role transfers to carry us through the QBR (attached: prioritization-matrix-v3.xlsx, interim-transfers-chart.pdf). This is intended to do three things:

- Give engineering and product clear rules for what to pause vs. what to keep funded through the next 6 weeks.
- Provide a temporary assignment plan for coverage where we have gaps due to departures and leaves.
- Make a lean announcement plan we can share in the QBR that signals stability but keeps options open.

Key assumptions: we hold customer-facing SLAs, freeze new major platform initiatives with >3-week runway, and prioritize retention work in two product teams. The matrix on tab 2 maps impact vs. cost with a recommended RAG.

Asks:
1) Please review the matrix and the transfer chart and leave comments in the linked doc by 12pm PT today (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1PriMatriXv3/edit).
2) Jonas/Karthik — I want your recommended list of 2–3 people to move to interim coverage per the chart; include expected duration.
3) Laura — can People Ops prep a short announcement draft and a compensation rubric for interim leads if approved?

I'll consolidate and circulate a QBR slide by 3pm. If we can't land decisions today we should at minimum agree on the triage rules so managers can message teams.

Thanks —

Soojin Lee
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
